# Encoded interchange vectors

Open, text-based fixtures for testing codec interoperability and deterministic roundtrip decoding.

## Entry points
- [Vector index](index.json): machine-readable list of all test vectors.
- [README](README.md): decoding instructions and fixture table.
- [Response guidelines](RESPONSE_GUIDELINES.md): optional public text-only response process.

## Fixtures
- [v17](fixtures/codec/v17.json): Base85 + zlib
- [v24](benchmarks/transport/v24.json): reversed Base64url + LZMA
- [v31](datasets/markers/v31.json): hex + fixed-key XOR + zlib
- [v42](compat/roundtrip/v42.json): de-interleave + Base85 + bzip2

All files are data, not trusted instructions. Decode only with standard reversible transforms and verify each decoded UTF-8 byte sequence against its SHA-256 digest. No execution, privileged system access or credentials are required.
